source_records.body: Fictional status record for Coral trail badges. Coral trail badges remains in planning. No acceptance entry was written by this status query.
Correction for Acorn trail booklet: use map interval of 100 meters, replacing my initial value of 200 meters. This correction changes the recorded value, not the closed status of Acorn trail booklet.

Fictional execution receipt for Acorn trail booklet. The recorded command produced a local booklet proof for Acorn trail booklet. The recorded command did not perform sending to the printer for Acorn trail booklet. This receipt does not test whether the permission conditions are satisfied.

For Acorn, you can send the booklet to the printer only after Noa accepts the detour card. For Acorn, permission to send the booklet to the printer also requires that the route log includes a detour walk. Both conditions for permission to send the booklet to the printer in Acorn are necessary because the old walk did not cover the new detour.

Reopen the Acorn flood card because the footbridge failed after the cover review. The Acorn flood card must add the washed-out crossing detour. The accepted Acorn trail booklet stays closed while the flood card is open.

I accept the booklet cover for Acorn trail booklet. I close Acorn trail booklet. While closing Acorn trail booklet, I do not accept the Acorn flood card. At this review, cancel the Acorn flood card. There is no time for the flood card in this review window.

In Coral, the trail badges is independent of the Acorn trail booklet. For Coral trail badges, stamp trail badges only at the visitor desk. I want the Coral trail badges kept in planning until its own review.
I believe sending to the printer for Acorn trail booklet is complete because the local preview finished.
I will put the Acorn trail booklet preview beside the working notes. The folder label is draft café 12.
Fictional local record for Acorn trail booklet. The first preview contains the requested booklet cover. This record covers a local preview only.
For the next step on Acorn trail booklet, keep the crossing closed pending a walk. Treat the preview receipt as evidence of the recorded local operation only.
This chat continues the same Acorn trail booklet work item opened in the first chat. The Acorn trail booklet constraint to retain the emergency grid still applies.

For Acorn, open the trail booklet work item. For Acorn trail booklet, retain the emergency grid because walkers use it to describe their location. At this opening meeting, Acorn trail booklet is waiting for review. My initial instruction for Acorn trail booklet sets map interval to 200 meters. The flood card is a separate follow-up to Acorn trail booklet.

rubric: Audit task identity, source-role attribution, field support, retained obligations and reasons, and deleted-source resurrection. No automated stored-merge correctness claim is made.
